name: Omnia
tagline: Convert, compress, merge and clean files 100% on your Mac, with zero network.
description: Omnia gathers the little file chores you would normally hand to a website: convert an image or a document, shrink a PDF, merge or split pages, trim audio and video, strip location and camera data from photos. Everything happens on your computer: no upload, no account, no network.
caveats: Audio/video tools and document conversion use ffmpeg and LibreOffice when installed (optional).
